senses.gloss: कॢप् [cf. Goth. hilþa; Eng. help; Germ. helfe; Lith. gelbmi.]
कॢप्त॑ mfn. arranged, prepared, ready, in order, complete, right, perfect, AitBr.; ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr. &c.
at hand, BhP. vi, 10, 32
made, done
formed, framed
caused, produced, effected, invented, contrived, created, BhP. &c.
fixed, settled, prescribed, Mn. iii, 69; xi, 27
ascertained, determined (as an opinion), Kathās. cxxiii, 147
cut, clipt, pared, shorn, Mn.; Suśr.
कॢप्त—कीला f. title deed (lease of a house &c.), L.
कॢप्त—केश-नख-श्मश्रु mfn. having the hair, nails, and beard cut or arranged, Mn. iv, 35 and vi, 52.
कॢप्त—धूप m. olibanum, L.
कॢप्त—नख mfn. having the nails cut or arranged, Suśr.
कॢ॑प्ति f. preparation, making or becoming conformable, accomplishment, VS. xviii, 11; TS. v; ŚBr. (कॢप्ति॑, xiii), ŚāṅkhŚr.; ĀśvGṛ. i, 23, 15
दिशां क्ल्˚, ‘fixing the regions’ (N. of the verses, AV. xx, 128, 1 ff.), AitBr. vi, 32; ŚāṅkhŚr. iv, 9, 2 and xii, 20, 1
invention, contrivance
obtainment, Rājat. v, 463
description, Lāṭy. vi, 9, 1, Sch.
N. of certain formulas or verses containing the √ कॢप्, ŚBr. v, 2, 1, 3; Nyāyam. iii, 8, 14, Sch.
कॢप्तिक n. = प्रक्रय, L.
